name: Lesson classify (one category per BLOCK finding)

knobs.note: BH-5806: 0 stops the lane before any request. Read by bin/lesson-classify.sh as ${LESSON_CLASSIFY_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/lesson-classify.log and the default.

BH-5806: BLOCK verdicts one tick asks for (GET /api/block-classify/pending?limit=), so at most this many model calls a tick. Read by bin/lesson-classify.sh as ${LESSON_CLASSIFY_MAX_PER_TICK:-5}; outside 1..50 is one warn line and the default.
BH-5806: seconds one classify call may run (bin/agent-call.sh timeout). Read by bin/lesson-classify.sh as ${LESSON_CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_S:-120}; outside 30..600 is one warn line and the default.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
